message: the live reader frames the reply on bytes, never on Characters — keep complete() feeding StreamedReply.consume(byte:), so it and the recorded-bytes test seam stay one parser
because: review of c670043: bytes.lines is AsyncLineSequence, which breaks on U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 — legal unescaped inside a JSON string and routine in text pasted from a PDF — while the test seam's String split did not, so no test could reach the delta production was dropping
